name: symfony
description: Personal Symfony conventions — FormType design (data_class as single source of truth, DataTransformer placement), Twig component patterns (trans_default_domain isolation), Post/Redirect/Get for HTML controllers, and testing anything that boots a Symfony kernel (WebTestCase built-in assertions, TypeTestCase, container doubles). Use alongside php (language) and phpunit (framework-agnostic testing). Distinct from atournayre/symfony — these are personal overlays.
